pci_regressor.note: This value is the road-condition classifier's real test accuracy, retrained on the actual DUCAR master inventory. It replaces a previous figure implied to be a Pavement Condition Index regression R², trained on rainfall/ESAL/maintenance-frequency features that do not exist anywhere in the real DUCAR dataset. Field name test_r2_score is kept for site compatibility; the underlying metric is classification accuracy, not R².

intervention_classifier.note: Not retrained in this pass — no real 'intervention' labels (Urgent Reconstruction / Periodic Resurfacing / Routine Maintenance) exist in the DUCAR dataset to train against honestly. The live intervention estimate on this page is a client-side formula, not this field.
